- docs/plans/stateless-pr-status-master-checker-plan.md: A.5 step 2 lines 383-392 and A.6 pickup lines 456-460 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: --enable output enable <tridg id> but the script's inputs (--enabled file from list_triggers with enabled: true and include_completed: true from the stal sweep, plus --sessions file) do not contain the disabled tick Routine's trigger id. When the master is dormant its tick Routine has enabled: false and is absent from the --enabled file. The same gap exists in --revive-scan which takes --enabled from pickup step 1's list_triggers (enabled: true only).
  WHY: An arming session or the pickup that gets enable <trig id> from the script would receive the instruction to re-enable a dormant master but without a usable trigger id to feed to update_trigger. The implementer coding --ensure and --revive-scan against this spec will discover they cannot produce the enable output from the specified inputs.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- docs/plans/stateless-pr-status-master-checker-plan.md: A.5 step 2, lines 383-392 (`check_in_master.py --ensure`); cross-reference A.3 step 3 line 252 (dormant → `update_trigger enabled: false`) and A.4 step 5 line 367 (dormancy trigger). | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The `--ensure` script is specified to output `enable <trig id>` for a dormant master (line 391) so the model can call `update_trigger` with `enabled: true`, but its only inputs are `--enabled <file>` (a `list_triggers enabled: true` snapshot) and `--sessions <list_sessions file>`, which cannot supply the disabled tick Routine's id.
  WHY: The first arm after a master goes dormant either cannot produce the required trigger id or may return `create` and create a duplicate master session, so the documented dormancy-revival contract cannot be satisfied.
- docs/plans/stateless-pr-status-master-checker-plan.md: A.4 step 6, line 369-370 (`Call stale_routines.classify on the ended file`). | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  PROBLEM: The plan says the master invokes `stale_routines.classify` on the ended file and emits its `delete` ids as `stale_delete`, but does not document behavior when `classify` raises.
  WHY: An exception inside the classifier can prevent the tick from emitting action output or make the master's reply `done` with no actions, causing the dead-man switch to fire for every subscriber.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

  PROBLEM: `--ensure` accepts `--enabled <file>` (from `list_triggers` with `enabled: true`) and `--sessions <file>`, but neither input contains the disabled tick's trigger id needed for the specified `enable <trig id>` output.
  WHY: The dormancy-reenable path requires the trigger id to re-enable the tick; as specified, `--ensure` cannot produce that output.
